title: Slowly Increasing Steer
source_docs: Vehicle Dynamics Blockset/Vehicle Scenarios/Drive Cycle and Maneuvers/Slowly_Increasing_Steer.md
text: 生成执行线性增加转向机动的指令，输入 2 路、输出 2 路；{Maneuver start time, tStart [s]} 指定开始时间、{Longitudinal velocity setpoint, velRef} 指定目标速度、{Longitudinal velocity setpoint units, velRefUnit []} 指定单位 mph、{Steer and countersteer speed, steerRate [deg/s]} 指定转向和反向转向速率、{Steer amplitude, steerAmp [deg]} 指定方向盘转向幅度、{Steering hold time after max angle reached, tStop [s]} 指定转向保持时间、{Lateral acceleration absolute threshold, ay_max [g]} 指定横向加速度阈值、{Initial steer direction} 指定初始转向方向、{Stop simulation at lateral acceleration threshold} 用于在横向加速度阈值处停止仿真，按实例取值。

ports.name: ay
ports.summary: 车辆横向加速度阈值 scalar

params.name: Steer and countersteer speed, steerRate [deg/s]
params.values: 转向和反向转向速率 13.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Steer amplitude, steerAmp [deg]
params.values: 方向盘转向幅度 270 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Steering hold time after max angle reached, tStop [s]
params.values: 转向保持时间 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Lateral acceleration absolute threshold, ay_max [g]
params.values: 横向加速度阈值 0.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Initial steer direction
params.values: 初始转向方向 Right (default) | Left

params.name: Stop simulation at lateral acceleration threshold
params.values: 用于在横向加速度阈值处停止仿真的选项 off (default) | on
